title: Communes urbaines : des acteurs s’approprient le nouveau plan d’adressage
why: Q2: describes the digital urban addressing system for Ouagadougou and Bobo-Dioulasso (pilot extent) and the plan supplied to police, gendarmerie and firefighters (Q3, Q4).

title: Grand Ouaga : un pas de géant dans la maîtrise de ses données urbaines
why: Q2: describes urban address-data platforms for Ouagadougou and Bobo-Dioulasso, extensible but not yet nationwide (Q3).

title: Burkina : « Nous pouvons identifier un ménage à Ouagadougou à travers une base de données », Valentin Bayiri
why: Q2: reports the digitised address database and street numbering in Ouagadougou, with intended use for waste, security and tax (Q4).

title: Burkina : La commune de Ouagadougou se dote d’un nouvel adressage urbain
why: Q4: numbered streets, household identification, pilot extent, and intended access for ONEA, SONABEL, deliveries and security services.

title: Code postal
why: Q4: La Poste uses structured addresses (street, locality or village, postal code) for delivery; not proof of a national address register.

title: Burkina Faso — addressing guide
why: Q3: documents the national postal address format and its use by La Poste; not evidence of a nationwide digital register.
